title: Watch sunrise from the Grand Canyon’s South Rim
description: Reach a South Rim viewpoint while the canyon is still shadowed and let the first light move across its layered walls. In winter the air can be sharp and a dusting of snow may outline the rock, though neither snow nor a clear sky is guaranteed. A short visit to a rim overlook can offer a vast experience without a descent into the canyon.
teaser: Let morning light reveal the canyon layer by layer.
goodToKnow: South Rim open year-round; snow is not guaranteed. Cold, ice and transport schedules need checking.
whyItMightDelightYou: The view changes minute by minute, giving you a reason to stay after the first photograph.
